purpose: Evaluate classification performance across 5 broader conditions (baseline, benign, jitter fault with action, jitter fault with no-action, authorized source failover) and validate the revised integrated runner against post-seal append defects.
development_exclusion: All V1-V5 and S11 historical runs are excluded from S14 parameter selection and estimation.
topology: Two independent L2 bridges. Master A on segment 1, master B on segment 2. One slaveOnly ptp4l with one port on each segment.

authorized_source_failover.expected_receiver_state: BMCA failover to master B upon announce receipt timeout

prespecified_interpretation.classification_validity: Zero false triggers in baseline_clean, benign_delay_jitter, and authorized_source_failover arms (specificity = 1.0). High sensitivity in jitter_fault arms.
prespecified_interpretation.recovery_separation: Action arm exhibits 100% active port failover to segment 2, while no_action control exhibits 0% failover despite identical impairment.
prespecified_interpretation.integrity_requirement: All writers must exit with returncode 0 recorded in writer_exit_status.tsv, FIFO drained on EOF, and source_manifest.sha256 exactly matching all on-disk files without post-seal appending.

decision_boundary: S14 evaluates software-level packet statistics, protocol state transitions, and segment failover. It establishes no claims regarding physical clock phase accuracy, hardware conformance, or external cyber-attack attribution.
